note: texture[i] = dword[8]; first np dwords = V (row), next np dwords = U (column), 16.16 fixed point in texels of a 256x256 page; page = bits 24..31 of the V dwords (low byte cleared by the engine). u/v = split for 4-vertex polygons and billboards, u3/v3 = split for triangles. Vertex k of a polygon uses (u[k], v[k]) in texel units (0..256, divide by 256 for normalised UV; 0 = top/left edge of the page). 'texdata' = TMD_TEXDATA loaded at textures[1..]; 'stadium' = TMD_STADIUM loaded at textures[1004..] (overrides texdata 1004..1006).
